donohue-2008-u2.citation: Donohue, Hamilton, Leben, Watts and Waddell (2008), Survey of Deepwater Currents in the Northwestern Gulf of Mexico, Volume II: Technical Report, OCS Study MMS 2008-031, June 2008.
donohue-2008-u2.access: Original MMS report SHA-verified. Actual title, naming discussion, source prose values and named January map reviewed on PDF pages 2, 150, 173, 178 and 181. Values transcribed from prose, not digitized from pixels. The original report explicitly defines the northern U2 branch separately from southern Ulysses.

records.definition: Source-reported area bounded by the 10 cm SSH-anomaly contour for the northern U2 branch on the stated analysis date.
records.scope: Explicitly named U2 northern piece in the comparison with southern Ulysses. This contour-area reference is not a material boundary or whole-eddy width.
records.qualification: Preserve the source SSH-anomaly operator, native square kilometres and stated date. The SSH reference and scalar uncertainty are unspecified. February and April use the explicitly defined Ulysses-before/U2-after composite northern-branch context. Pre-split parent Ulysses values and the separate southern Ulysses area are excluded from U2. Source-date support does not establish exact sampling time, formation or lifetime. No radius, diameter, principal width, annual envelope, continuous shrinkage, physical footprint, state containment, ranking or seasonal playback inferred.
